name.en: Probe: what the area-move refusal reads
name.ja: プローブ: エリア移動の拒否が何を読むか

description.en: During AreaMoveManager.execute, records every attribute read on app, the manager, the player and the party members, every key read on their relationship dict and on app.party / original_party / world.characters, until area_move_rejector or elapse_days is called. Shows the refusal branch's inputs without the source.
description.ja: AreaMoveManager.execute の間、area_move_rejector か elapse_days が呼ばれるまでの app・マネージャ・プレイヤー・同行者の属性読みと、relationship / app.party / original_party / world.characters の鍵読みを全部記録する。拒否の分岐が何を見ているかをソース無しで割り出す
